_about: Settings for the offline Georgia basemap (georgia.pmtiles). Read by scripts/build_basemap.sh and scripts/basemap.py. Bump 'version' whenever anything here changes, and say why in 'changelog'. The owner's decision: full quality (every OpenMapTiles layer, buildings, land cover, land use, water, house numbers and every POI, no lean variant), Georgian and English names only, built from the same safety-clipped extract as the routing tiles.
changelog: 1 (2026-09-26): first version. Planetiler 0.10.2 (jar SHA-256 from GitHub's release asset digest, the same value as the planetiler.jar.sha256 file of the release, checked 2026-09-26), bundled planetiler-openmaptiles at commit 91516fdf (OpenMapTiles schema 3.16.0). Source URLs are the ones Planetiler 0.10.2's openmaptiles task uses by default. Spot-check points and thresholds were calibrated on OpenFreeMap's Planetiler-built OpenMapTiles tiles (build 20260913_164504_pt) on 2026-09-26; the size band is a guess until the first green run.

2 (2026-09-26): licence review. build.archive_description now carries the ODbL notice and URI and the OpenMapTiles CC-BY 4.0 credit inside georgia.pmtiles (ODbL 4.2), and the gate requires it; the gate also requires the linked credits (openmaptiles.org, openstreetmap.org/copyright) in the attribution. The licence note lists what planetiler.jar bundles (LGPL GeoTools and the EPSG data, EDL JTS, ICU); none of it ships.

planetiler._note: planetiler.jar (Apache-2.0; also bundles LGPL GeoTools shapefile/EPSG-HSQL, which also carries the EPSG dataset terms, EDL JTS, ICU and others per its NOTICE.md at the pinned commit) and planetiler-openmaptiles (BSD-3 code, CC-BY-4.0 schema). CI only, never distributed; the output is data, not a derivative of this code.

build.archive_description: OpenMapTiles 3.16.0 schema for Georgia, names in Georgian and English, built by Planetiler from a safety-clipped OpenStreetMap extract: every road inside the occupied territories (plus 100 m) and outside Georgia is removed. Data © OpenStreetMap contributors, a derivative database under the Open Database License 1.0 (https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/); layers follow the OpenMapTiles schema, CC-BY 4.0 (https://openmaptiles.org/).
build._note: Every OpenMapTiles layer is kept (no --exclude-layers, no --only-layers). --bounds is the bounding box of config/boundaries/georgia_28699.geojson plus bounds_margin_deg on each side, so a wrong or missing PBF header can never turn this into a world build. Wikidata name lookups stay off: every name comes from the OSM extract. archive_description is the PMTiles 'description': it carries the ODbL notice inside the file (ODbL 4.2), which the gate checks. The default --archive-attribution (Planetiler's OpenMapTiles credit with both links) is kept.

gate._size_note: OpenFreeMap's Georgia z0-14 slice (every language) measured 140.1 MB on 2026-09-22; with only ka and en it should be smaller. Tighten the band after the first green run. The comparison with the previous release (drop_limit) is the stronger check.

no_go_scan._note: Every line in the transportation and transportation_name layers whose class is a road class (or any *_construction class) must stay out of the no-go area (occupied areas plus 100 m, less hard_margin_m for tile rounding) and inside Georgia (plus country_margin_m). Railways, aerialways, piers and bridges are not roads and pass the clip, as do railway platforms without a highway tag (class path, subclass platform). Polygons are not checked: a pedestrian square mapped as a multipolygon relation keeps its outline. Place labels, buildings, land use and POIs inside the occupied areas stay on the map on purpose.
no_go_scan._calibration: On 2026-09-26 the scan was run on OpenFreeMap's unclipped tiles around Tskhinvali, Sukhumi and Upper Lars: it found 3,158 road lines in the no-go area and 29 on the Russian side, and 12,979 building outlines in just 18 tiles touching the no-go area. Tiles near Gori were skipped as legal.

gate._spot_note: Measured on OpenFreeMap's Planetiler OpenMapTiles tiles on 2026-09-26 (named streets / with Georgian name:ka / building outlines / POIs / POIs with name:ka / house numbers): Tbilisi 14/10230/6100 286/270/3216/4798/1628/269, Batumi 14/10086/6103 68/66/2295/5455/1471/412 (with sea), Kutaisi 14/10135/6065 215/211/4234/1189/339/315. The minimums are about a quarter to a third of that, so normal OSM edits never block a release but a missing layer or language does. Buildings are counted as polygon outlines: Planetiler merges a tile's buildings into a few multipolygon features.
